transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
Ever since they changed everything at school, I feel like I’m not handling it well at all. My reactions to the stress are really taking over my life, and it's getting to be too much.
How long ago did these changes at school occur, and how long have you been experiencing these stressful reactions?

The changes at my school were put in place about five months ago. My stressful reactions started almost immediately—within just a few weeks of the restructuring—and it has been going on consistently ever since then.
Along with the stress from school, have you been experiencing a consistently low mood or a loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in things I used to love, like my watercolor sessions and salsa nights. My mood has been incredibly low and drained, to the point where I find myself crying in my car before school. I've also been too exhausted and irritable to engage with my husband or go to family get-togethers anymore.
Have you also been experiencing any changes in your sleep patterns or appetite since these feelings of low mood and exhaustion began?

My sleep has definitely been affected because I lie awake for hours replaying work stress, test scores, and lesson scripts in my head, often staying up very late just trying to keep up with my planning. However, I haven't noticed any real changes in my appetite.
Have you also been experiencing feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or hopelessness during this time?

I don't really feel completely hopeless or worthless as a person, but I do constantly feel like I'm failing my students under this new system. It's just a really heavy, frustrating feeling that I can't do my job the way they need me to anymore.
Have you noticed any difficulties with your concentration, focusing on tasks, or making decisions recently?

I haven't really noticed specific problems with my concentration or making decisions. It's just that I feel so exhausted, and I've found that my lesson planning is taking much longer than it usually does.
During this difficult time, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or feelings that you would be better off dead?

No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or wanting to die. Even though I feel incredibly overwhelmed, exhausted, and unlike myself because of all the stress at school, I have never had those kinds of thoughts.
Have you or those close to you noticed that you are moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or on the other hand, that you feel physically restless and unable to sit still?

No, I haven't noticed myself moving or speaking more slowly, nor have I felt physically restless or unable to sit still. I do feel very drained, tired, and irritable most of the time, but not restless in that way.
Have you ever experienced a similar period of low mood, exhaustion, or loss of interest in the past, especially during times when there wasn't a major stressor in your life?

No, I have never experienced anything like this in the past. I have always been a very grounded, optimistic, and energetic person, so these feelings of exhaustion and losing interest are completely new to me and only started after the major changes at my school.
Have these feelings of low mood and loss of interest been present nearly every day, for most of the day, since they first started?

Yes, they have been present almost every single day for the past five months since the restructuring started. It feels like a constant emotional roller coaster and I'm living in perpetual work-related tension, dreading every single school day and completely giving up on my watercolors and salsa dancing.
